# Asset index

Every asset in this video is generated by a script in `video/` from something
already in the repository. Nothing was drawn by hand, licensed, or downloaded,
so there is no third-party asset to attribute and nothing to re-license.

## Generated by the pipeline

| Asset | Path | Made by | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Narration, one wav per scene | `audio/vo/S01.wav` … `S18.wav` | `build_audio.py` | the narration in `script/scenes.json`, spoken by espeak-ng |
| Measured timeline | `script/timeline.json` | `build_audio.py` | the duration of each wav |
| Subtitles | `subtitles/project.srt` | `build_audio.py` | narration split by sentence across the measured speech span |
| Motion scene pages | `assets/scenes/S01.html` … | `build_scenes.py` | the timeline, with every cue tied to the voice |
| Caption overlays (transparent PNG) | `assets/overlays/S09.png` … `S15.png` | `build_overlays.py` + `render_overlays.mjs` | the `onscreen` field of each screen scene |
| Architecture diagram | `assets/diagrams/architecture.svg` | hand-authored SVG | `core/gate/checks.py`, `deploy/app.py`, `tests/test_invariants.py` |
| Product take | `recording/page@*.webm` + `recording/marks.json` | `record_walkthrough.mjs` | a cold local instance driven through the runbook flow |
| Motion takes | `recording/scenes/S*/**.webm` + `scene-marks.json` | `render_scenes.mjs` | the scene pages |
| Per-scene cuts | `render/S01.mp4` … `S18.mp4` | `compose.py` | the takes, cut on marks |
| Mixed audio | `render/_audio.wav` | `compose.py` | narration at its cue over a pink-noise bed at −42 dB |
| Final film | `final/final_project_video.mp4` | `compose.py` | the assembly, with subtitles burned in |
| QA frames | `qa/frames/S01.png` … | `qa.py` | the delivered file, sampled per scene |

## Type and colour

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Display and body | **Inter Variable**, read from `console/node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter` — the console's own typeface, so the graphics and the product match |
| Data, labels, reason codes | **JetBrains Mono Variable**, from the same place |
| Subtitles | DejaVu Sans, via libass — the only guaranteed system face, chosen for legibility over consistency |
| Ground | `#06080b`, with two low radial washes |
| Allow / block / caution | `#5fd39b` / `#ff7a70` / `#f3c375` — the console's own semantics, so a green chip means the same thing in the graphics and in the product |

The fonts are read from the repository's own `node_modules`, so the render is
offline and reproducible; both are OFL-licensed.

## Sources of every number on screen

| Figure | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Arm A/B/C/D GMV, net, false block rate, losses | `eval/results/results.md`, generated by `python sim/run.py --all` |
| 0.0% false block, 27.8% for the naive cap | same |
| Crossover ≈ 20% | the sensitivity sweep in the same file — the swept point at which arm D wins, not an interpolation between two of them |
| 5 approved vs 20 approved, overspend of ₹15,000 | `tests/test_race.py` |
| The ten checks and their reason codes | `core/gate/checks.py` — the scene reads CHECK_ORDER rather than restating it — and `contracts/reason_codes.py` |
| `CEILING_PER_TXN` on the blind upsell | the recorded run itself (beat 3) |
| ₹15,000 / five purchases / three categories | the mandate the demo grants |

## Not used

No stock footage, no music library, no icon set, no AI-generated imagery, and no
logo other than the project's own wordmark set in Inter.
